4.26.eg: Fire detection: all detectors tested per PMS, panel without faults/isolated loops.
ex: Fire detection and alarm system tested regularly.
4.26.fg: Fire detection: lahat ng detector nasubukan ayon sa PMS, walang fault/isolated loop ang panel.
fc: Panel: walang fault, walang isolated zone
Test records na nagpapakitang nasubukan ang LAHAT ng detector sa cycle
Annual service report ng service company
fx: Regular na sinusubukan ang fire detection at alarm system.
Walang records o may isolated zones
ff: Hindi lahat ng detector nasubukan ayon sa PMS / may isolated loops o faults ang panel

4.27.eg: Fixed CO2 / foam / water mist: annual service, bottle weights, alarms, foam pump.
ex: Fixed fire-extinguishing systems (CO2, foam, water mist) checked and working.
Does not ask for a water mist test unless he sees a problem
Wants to see the foam pump turns freely
4.27.fg: Fixed CO2 / foam / water mist: annual service, timbang ng bote, alarms, foam pump.
fc: Annual service certificate ng CO2 system; 2-yearly blow-through; 10-yearly hydrotest/flexible hoses
Malinis at may hangin ang CO2 room, nakapaskil ang instructions, walang leak, pilot cylinders
Naka-record ang release alarm tests
Foam/water mist system ayon sa maker; malayang umiikot ang foam pump
📋 Inspector: Fixed CO2: 2-yearly service, cylinders hydrostatic test every 10 years
fx: Chine-check at gumagana ang fixed fire-extinguishing systems (CO2, foam, water mist).
Walang service o may halatang problema
Hindi humihingi ng water mist test maliban kung may nakitang problema
Gustong makita na malayang umiikot ang foam pump
ff: Overdue ang CO2 annual service / pagtimbang ng bote
Ginagamit na bodega ang CO2 room, hindi gumagana ang fan
Hindi alam ng crew ang release procedure

4.28.eg: Emergency fire pump starts at once, gives pressure, starting instructions posted.
ex: Emergency fire pump tested, in good condition, with starting instructions.
Does not start or gives no pressure
With C/E agreement he will see the start and running
If the Master agrees, he will also see a pressure/flow test
4.28.fg: Agad nag-i-start ang emergency fire pump, may pressure, nakapaskil ang starting instructions.
fc: Paandarin ang em'cy fire pump: nag-i-start, nagpi-prime, may pressure sa pinakamataas/pinakamalayong hydrant (2 jets)
Nakapaskil sa pump ang starting instructions sa English
Weekly test records; puno ang fuel tank; bukas ang suction valve
fx: Nasubukan at maayos ang emergency fire pump, may starting instructions.
Kung payag ang C/E, titingnan ang pag-start at pag-andar
Kung payag ang Master, titingnan din ang pressure/flow test
ff: Walang pressure ang emergency fire pump sa light draught / mabagal mag-prime
Hindi nakapaskil ang starting instructions, laging bukas ang pinto ng room

4.29.eg: Portable extinguishers: annual service, seals, pressure, correct location.
4.29.fg: Portable extinguishers: annual service, seals, pressure, tamang lugar.
fc: Annual service labels/certificate; 10-yearly hydrotest
Buo ang pins at seals, nasa green ang gauges, walang bitak ang hoses
Nasa lugar ayon sa fire plan; may spare charges
📋 Inspector: Portable foam applicators / extinguishers: Non-PFOS certificate (from 01.01.2026)
fx: Naaalagaan at handa ang portable extinguishers.
ff: Overdue ang service ng extinguisher / walang seal / walang spare charges

4.30.eg: Fireman's outfits complete, SCBA with spare cylinders, ATEX radios for each fire team.
ex: Fireman's outfits, ATEX radios and SCBA in good condition and ready to use.
Not enough intrinsically safe radios for the fire teams
SOLAS II-2/10: 2 radios per fire party
4.30.fg: Kumpleto ang fireman's outfits, SCBA na may spare cylinders, ATEX radios para sa bawat fire team.
fc: Kumpleto ang fireman's outfit: suit, boots, gloves, helmet, ATEX lamp, palakol, lifeline
SCBA: puno ang cylinders, hydrotest dates, face masks, monthly check, annual service
Intrinsically safe two-way radios ≥2 bawat fire party (finding kung kulang)
Gumagana ang komunikasyon kahit naka-helmet
📋 Inspector: SCBA cylinders: 5-yearly hydrostatic test; BA compressor annual air-quality analysis
fx: Maayos at agad magagamit ang fireman's outfits, ATEX radios at SCBA.
Kulang ang intrinsically safe radios para sa fire teams
Sinusubukan ang komunikasyon gamit ang radios
SOLAS II-2/10: 2 radio bawat fire party
ff: Kulang ang fireman's outfit (torch, palakol, lifeline, ATEX radio)
Hindi puno ang SCBA cylinders / walang spare cylinders
BA air quality test >12 buwan

4.31.eg: BA compressor: SMS procedure and annual air quality test.
ex: BA compressor in the SMS and annual air quality check.
4.31.fg: BA compressor: SMS procedure at annual air quality test.
fc: Air quality test certificate (taon-taon) ng BA compressor
Maintenance ng compressor nasa PMS; napalitan ang filters
fx: Nasa SMS ang BA compressor at may annual check ng kalidad ng hangin.

4.32.eg: EEBDs in place, in date, checked.
ex: EEBDs checked, in good condition and ready to use.
4.32.fg: EEBDs nasa lugar, hindi expired, na-check.
fc: EEBDs ayon sa fire plan sa accommodation at ER (+ spares)
Expiry/service dates, pressure gauges, seals
Monthly inspection records
fx: Na-check, maayos at agad magagamit ang EEBDs.
ff: Expired ang EEBD o wala sa lugar na nasa fire plan

4.33.eg: Fire dampers marked (open/close + space served) and tested.
ex: Fire dampers marked (open/close and space) and tested.
4.33.fg: May marka ang fire dampers (open/close + space na sineserbisyuhan) at nasubukan.
fc: Bawat damper may markang OPEN/CLOSED at space na sineserbisyuhan
Malayang gumagalaw (subukan ang ilan); test records
Kasama ang funnel/ER/galley dampers
fx: May marka (open/close at space) at nasubukan ang fire dampers.
ff: Walang markang open/close at space ang fire dampers
Naninigas ang dampers / hindi sumasara nang buo, wala sa PMS

4.34.eg: MSDS for all chemicals, bunkers, paints available near the spaces.
ex: MSDS for bunkers, chemicals, paints, and the crew know them.
4.34.fg: May MSDS ng lahat ng chemicals, bunkers, paints malapit sa mga space.
fc: MSDS ng lahat ng bunkers (HFO/VLSFO/MGO), lub oils, chemicals, paints
Kopya sa ECR, paint store, chemical store, bridge/CCR
Alam ng crew kung nasaan at ang pangunahing panganib
fx: May MSDS para sa bunkers, chemicals, paints, at alam ito ng crew.

4.35.eg: Safe access: gangway with safety net, lifebuoy, lighting, correct angle.
ex: Gangway without net, lifebuoy, light, or at a wrong angle
No finding if the ladder meets requirements and is rigged correctly
4.35.fg: Ligtas na daanan: gangway na may safety net, lifebuoy, ilaw, tamang anggulo.
fc: Tama ang rig ng gangway/accom. ladder, may safety net, mahigpit ang stanchions at handropes
Lifebuoy na may lubid sa gangway, sapat na ilaw
Pasok sa limit ang anggulo; inaayos sa pagbabago ng draft/tide
Malinis at walang harang ang daanan
fx: Ligtas na daanan papasok sa barko.
Gangway na walang net, lifebuoy, ilaw o mali ang anggulo
Walang finding kung pasok sa requirements ang ladder at tama ang rig
ff: Walang safety net ang gangway, maluwag o hindi buong haba
Walang lifebuoy na may lubid sa gangway / madilim sa gabi
Hindi binabantayan ang gangway, lampas sa limit ang anggulo, hindi pantay ang bottom platform

4.36.eg: Accommodation ladders/gangways: markings, inspection, PMS for turntable & pin, wires.
ex: Accommodation ladders and gangways maintained, marked and inspected.
Turntable and pin not in the PMS
Annual thorough examination, load test every 5 years
4.36.fg: Accommodation ladders/gangways: markings, inspection, PMS para sa turntable at pin, wires.
fc: May marka ang ladder: maker, model, max angle, max load
Inspection ng turntable at pin nasa PMS (finding kung wala)
Wires pinalitan ayon sa SMS; winch at limit switches
5-yearly load test at annual thorough exam records
fx: Naaalagaan, may marka at na-inspect ang accommodation ladders at gangways.
Wala sa PMS ang turntable at pin
Annual thorough examination, load test bawat 5 taon
ff: Hindi naka-record ang palit/inspection ng wire ng accommodation ladder
Wala sa PMS ang turntable at pivot pin, sira ang stanchions

4.37.eg: Pilot ladders: certificate, ID tag, usage records, ≤30 months, correct rigging.
ex: Pilot ladders in good condition, inspected, with ID and records, and crew know how to rig them.
Asks the crew to show correct rigging
Replace at the latest at 30 months
4.37.fg: Pilot ladders: certificate, ID tag, records ng gamit, ≤30 buwan, tamang rigging.
fc: Pilot ladder certificate at unique ID marking (ISO 799-1)
Usage log; pinalitan ≤30 buwan mula paggawa/paggamit
Maayos ang steps, spreaders, side ropes; nakakabit sa strongpoints, hindi shackle sa lubid
Kayang ipakita ng crew ang tamang rigging (combination arrangement)
fx: Maayos, na-inspect, may ID at records ang pilot ladders, at marunong mag-rig ang crew.
Pinapakita sa crew ang tamang rigging
ff: Hindi tugma ang certificate sa ID tag ng ladder / walang unique marking
Pilot ladder na >30 buwan nang ginagamit nang walang strength test
Gasgas ang side ropes, bulok sa ilalim ng clamps, maluwag o hindi pantay ang steps
Naka-shackle sa steps o sa railing imbes na sa strong points
Walang lifebuoy na may self-igniting light / heaving line / ilaw sa boarding station

4.38.eg: Ship-specific Fire Safety & SOLAS Training Manuals in mess rooms & cabins.
ex: Ship-specific Fire Safety and SOLAS Training Manuals.
4.38.fg: Ship-specific Fire Safety at SOLAS Training Manuals sa mess at cabins.
fc: Ship-specific Fire Safety Operational Booklet at Training Manual
SOLAS Training Manual sa bawat mess room at recreation room
Kopya ng fire control plan sa labas ng accommodation (sa box)
fx: Ship-specific na Fire Safety at SOLAS Training Manuals.
Chine-check ang mess rooms at cabins

4.39.eg: Helicopter area (if any): markings, Class strength letter, safe access.
ex: If there is a helicopter area: as per the ICS Guide and with safe access.
4.39.fg: Helicopter area (kung meron): markings, Class strength letter, ligtas na daanan.
fc: May Class strength confirmation letter sa barko (finding kung wala)
Markings ayon sa ICS Guide; mga harang; ligtas na daanan mula hatch cover papuntang deck
Kung hindi designated – handang ipaliwanag
fx: Kung may helicopter area: ayon sa ICS Guide at may ligtas na daanan.
Walang strength confirmation letter ng Class

4.41.eg: Helicopter ops: ICS checklist, risk assessment, communication records.
ex: Crew know the helicopter procedures, with checklist and risk assessment.
Checks records of the last operation
ICS Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations, Appendix B
4.41.fg: Helicopter ops: ICS checklist, risk assessment, communication records.
fc: ICS Helicopter/Ship checklist at risk assessment ng huling operation
Pamilyar ang crew sa helicopter procedures; may firefighting party allocation
fx: Alam ng crew ang helicopter procedures, may checklist at risk assessment.
Chine-check ang records ng huling operation
ICS Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations, Appendix B

4.42.eg: Lifebuoys (light/smoke/line), MOB, pyrotechnics in date and correctly placed.
ex: Lifebuoys, attachments and pyrotechnics in good condition.
Checks rockets are in place and re-fitted
4.42.fg: Lifebuoys (ilaw/smoke/lubid), MOB, pyrotechnics hindi expired at nasa tamang lugar.
fc: Lifebuoys: pangalan at port ng barko, retro-tape, hindi expired ang self-igniting lights/smoke, tamang haba ng lubid
Bridge-wing MOB na may quick release
Rockets/line-throwing apparatus/hand flares hindi expired at nasa lugar
fx: Maayos ang lifebuoys, attachments at pyrotechnics.
Chine-check kung nasa lugar at naibalik ang rockets
ff: Expired / hindi gumagana ang lifebuoy light o smoke signal
Naiipit ang release ng bridge-wing MOB, bulok ang lubid

4.43.eg: Familiarisation of new crew complete and signed.
ex: Familiarisation for new joiners and for those changing position.
4.43.fg: Kumpleto at may pirma ang familiarisation ng bagong crew.
fc: Familiarisation checklists ng pinakabagong sakay – kumpleto bago magtrabaho
Kasama ang safety, emergency duties, job-specific
fx: Familiarisation para sa bagong sakay at sa mga nagpalit ng posisyon.
ff: Hindi natapos/napirmahan ang familiarisation ng bagong sakay sa takdang oras

4.44.eg: Procedure for controlling stevedores (hazards, hold entry).
ex: A procedure to control stevedores (hazards and measures).
The Master has the final word, also for enclosed space entry
4.44.fg: Procedure sa pagkontrol ng stevedores (panganib, pagpasok sa hold).
fc: SMS procedure para sa stevedore control at hazard briefing
Stevedore safety briefing records / signage
Sinusunod ng stevedores ang enclosed space/hold entry rules
fx: May procedure sa pagkontrol ng stevedores (panganib at mga hakbang).
Ang Master ang may huling salita, pati sa enclosed space entry

5.1.eg: ORB Part I correctly completed (codes, quantities, signatures), matches soundings.
ex: Oil Record Book Part I correctly completed.
Wrong codes or quantities, or signatures missing
5.1.fg: ORB Part I tamang napunan (codes, dami, pirma), tugma sa soundings.
fc: Tamang codes (C, D, I, H…) at format ayon sa MEPC.1/Circ.736
Ang dami ng sludge/bilge ay tugma sa tank soundings at IOPP Form A
Bawat entry may pirma ng officer, bawat pahina ng Master
Entries ng bunkering, sludge disposal (resibo), incinerator
May Flag approval ang e-ORB
fx: Tamang napunan ang Oil Record Book Part I.
Mali ang codes o dami, o kulang ang pirma
Kung e-ORB, chine-check ang Flag approval

5.2.eg: SOPEP approved, contact list updated, SOPEP locker complete.
ex: Approved and updated SOPEP, and crew know their duties.
Old contact list or crew do not know
5.2.fg: Aprubado ang SOPEP, updated ang contact list, kumpleto ang SOPEP locker.
fc: Aprubadong SOPEP; updated ang national contact list (Appendix)
Kumpleto at naka-seal ang SOPEP locker inventory; naka-record ang drills
Alam ng crew ang tungkulin nila
fx: Aprubado at updated ang SOPEP, at alam ng crew ang tungkulin nila.
Lumang contact list o hindi alam ng crew

5.3.eg: Annex V knowledge: cargo residues, HME, garbage disposal, special areas.
ex: Crew know MARPOL Annex V (garbage, cargo residues).
5.3.fg: Kaalaman sa Annex V: cargo residues, HME, pagtapon ng basura, special areas.
fc: Alam ng crew ang rules sa cargo residues/hold wash water discharge
Nakapaskil ang garbage placard; tamang label ng segregation bins
Hold washing entries sa GRB
fx: Alam ng crew ang MARPOL Annex V (basura, cargo residues).

5.5.eg: No leaks at bulkheads (holds, ER, ballast).
ex: No visible leaks at the bulkheads.
5.5.fg: Walang leak sa bulkheads (holds, ER, ballast).
fc: Hanapin ang leak/mantsa sa bulkheads sa holds, ER, pipe duct
I-check ang lower stool ng transverse bulkheads

5.6.eg: Hold bilge system: wells clean, strum boxes, non-return valves, tests.
ex: Hold bilge system correctly arranged, in good condition, tested.
5.6.fg: Hold bilge system: malinis ang wells, strum boxes, non-return valves, tests.
fc: Malinis ang hold bilge wells, nasa lugar ang strainers/covers
Nasubukan ang non-return valves; bilge suction test records
Gumagana ang bilge alarms (WIDS)
fx: Tama ang ayos, maayos at nasubukan ang hold bilge system.
Chine-check ang wells, strainers, non-return valves

5.7.eg: Soundings of bilges/ballast/voids/chain lockers recorded daily.
ex: Regular soundings of bilges, ballast, chain lockers, pipe duct, voids.
5.7.fg: Soundings ng bilges/ballast/voids/chain lockers naka-record araw-araw.
fc: Daily sounding book: hold bilges, ballast, voids, chain lockers, pipe duct
May takip/ID marking ang sounding pipes; may sounding tape
fx: Regular na soundings sa bilges, ballast, chain lockers, pipe duct, voids.

5.8.eg: Save-alls / containment around hydraulic deck machinery, clean.
ex: Containment around the hydraulics of deck machinery.
5.8.fg: Save-alls / containment sa paligid ng hydraulic deck machinery, malinis.
fc: Drip trays/coamings sa ilalim ng winches, windlass, crane at hatch hydraulics
Malinis, walang langis; may drain plugs
Walang hydraulic leak sa deck
fx: May containment sa paligid ng hydraulics ng deck machinery.

5.9.eg: Pump/means for fore peak & spaces forward of the collision bulkhead – marked.
ex: Means of pumping the spaces forward of the collision bulkhead, marked.
5.9.fg: Pump/paraan para sa fore peak at spaces sa unahan ng collision bulkhead – may marka.
fc: Gumagana ang bilge pumping ng bosun store / fwd spaces (eductor/portable)
Malinaw ang marka; may test records
fx: May paraan ng pag-pump sa spaces sa unahan ng collision bulkhead, may marka.

5.10.eg: BWMP, BWTS working & maintained, Ballast Water Record Book correct.
ex: BWMP, BWTS maintained per maker, correct Ballast Water Record Book.
BWTS not working or records have errors
5.10.fg: BWMP, gumagana at naaalagaan ang BWTS, tama ang Ballast Water Record Book.
fc: Aprubado ang BWMP; alam ng officers
Umaandar ang BWTS, walang alarm; maintenance ayon sa maker (UV lamps, filters)
Ang BWRB entries ay tugma sa deck log at BWTS logs
Naka-record at na-report ang exceptions/bypass
📋 Inspector: BWM certificate + BWMS type / annual report; BWMS & EGCS on-board training records
fx: BWMP, BWTS na naaalagaan ayon sa maker, tamang Ballast Water Record Book.
Hindi gumagana ang BWTS o may mali ang records
ff: Hindi gumagana ang BWTS / hindi calibrated ang TRO sensor
Hindi tugma ang BWRB entries sa deck log
Hindi alam ng officer ang BWTS alarms at bypass reporting

5.12.eg: Ballast checked for oil before deballasting (if next to FO tanks).
ex: Ballast checked for oil before deballasting, if next to fuel tanks.
5.12.fg: Chine-check ang ballast kung may langis bago mag-deballast (kung katabi ng FO tanks).
fc: Procedure sa pag-check ng langis sa ballast bago i-discharge (visual/sample)
Records ng check bago mag-deballast
fx: Chine-check ang ballast kung may langis bago mag-deballast, kung katabi ng fuel tanks.

5.13.eg: Emergency bilge suction & overboard valves marked with warning; clean area.
ex: Emergency bilge suction and overboard valves marked with a warning, and the area clean.
5.13.fg: Emergency bilge suction at overboard valves may marka at babala; malinis ang area.
fc: Emergency bilge suction valve may markang 'Emergency use only' + warning notice; malinis ang area
Overboard discharge valve naka-seal/naka-lock at may marka
Test procedure nasa PMS
fx: May marka at babala ang emergency bilge suction at overboard valves, at malinis ang area.
Walang marka o marumi ang area

5.14.eg: Sludge pump with no connection to overboard.
ex: The sludge pump must have no connection to overboard.
5.14.fg: Sludge pump na walang koneksyon papuntang overboard.
fc: Sundan ang discharge ng sludge pump: sa shore connection/incinerator lang
Walang cross-connection papuntang overboard (kahit naka-blank)
fx: Ang sludge pump ay dapat walang koneksyon papuntang overboard.
